item.description:

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syrian forces entered the Roj camp ahead of foreign repatriations, and clashes between two families in Aleppo caused deaths and injuries. Flooding in Erbil and Kirkuk has caused deaths and missing persons, and protests have blocked the Mosul-Erbil road in the Nineveh Plains, while smuggling of petroleum products was foiled in Diyala and Nineveh.
